as_told.title: McConnell recalls a source visibly shaking

plain: Some people who came to brief US Senate staff on what they knew about UFOs were so nervous that they shook, according to Kurt McConnell, a Senate staffer who sat in on those briefings on Capitol Hill from around 2017. He tells Michels he recalls one source who "was visibly shaking" as they began to explain what they knew. In a later episode, prompted by Michels, he speaks more broadly of sources who were "extremely earnest," had "credible backgrounds," and were "nervous and they're shaking." He tells it as a sign that these people believed what they were saying and felt it was risky to say it.
